title: Catalog VERDICT.json
description: Canonical eval result for one catalog tool. scripts/catalog_apply_verdict.py reads this file and generates the one-line VERDICT from it. Do not keep a second hand-written verdict that can disagree. The one-line file is ACTION, a stage I0-I4, then the metric, threshold, and both gates. ACTION is PROMOTE, STAY, or DEMOTE.

metric.description: Name of the measured value. Example: probe_score.

threshold.description: Gate cutoff for metric. The apply script does not recompute the measurement.

value_gate.description: Value gate from docs/ops/integration-stages.md. Required to pass before a write of I3 or I4.

modularity_gate.description: Modularity gate from docs/ops/integration-stages.md. Required to pass before a write of I2 or above.

proposed_stage.description: Stage the eval wants written. The apply script refuses a value above the evidence ceiling and tier_ceiling. It does not promote just because the ceiling allows a higher stage.

intent.description: Optional. A new write must be an enum value or an alias. The apply script does not rewrite the intent already stored on a card. Enum: awareness, catalog_default, staged_evaluation, ad_hoc_probe, onboard, embedded. Aliases: staged_eval -> staged_evaluation, adhoc_probe -> ad_hoc_probe, ad-hoc-probe -> ad_hoc_probe, ad-hoc_probe -> ad_hoc_probe.
